correctness.rationale: The fixed first path/uniform second permutation reduction is valid. For any fixed mixed falling-factorial moment of (A_n,B_n), disjoint selected signed directed edges contribute 1+O(1/n); incompatible orientations contribute zero and compatible overlapping path fragments at most O(1/n) in aggregate, since a t-arc directed-forest requirement has probability 1/(n)_t. All mixed moments converge to 1, yielding independent Poisson(1). Two-variable unary ranks c1,c2 are exactly the pair-mask/color-refinement supports: binary qrank<=1 formulas reduce to pair atomic masks and unary rank<=1 facts, so qrank<=3 sentences depend on the SET of c2 types. The high-probability separation of 4 endpoints and O_P(1) overlap edges makes all nonordinary c1 roles localized and distinct. A vertex can exclude at most one occurrence of a given special c1 role from its non-neighbor support; therefore c2 types depend only on multiplicities 0/1/>=2 of aligned and reversed edges. Ordinary role is abundant. Conversely nested two-variable ∃x∃y with shadowed overlap witnesses expresses >=2, and existential rank-two formulas express >=1, yielding all nine cells at rank three; rank two sees just presence bits. The 4+4+1 Poisson cell masses give 5*5*2=50 distinct subset sums and 2*3*2=12 at rank two; transcendence of e makes different integer-coefficient polynomials inequivalent. Independently enumerated every second order for n=3..8, all nine clean c2 type classes in 88 accepted synthetic n=2000 models, and all 50/12 polynomial expressions. Tests corroborate but DO NOT PROVE the infinite high-probability lemma or the rank quantifier-induction; those follow from the reconstructed argument.

originality.rationale: The exact independent Poisson(1) law for both directed overlap counts and the rank-two twelve-point spectrum are ALREADY covered, respectively, by published 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-02 theorems for arbitrary fixed numbers of independent successor paths. They are not credited as fresh findings. The surviving claim is the rank-THREE FO2 completeness of the 9 truncated count cells, all 50 possible limiting probabilities, and proof of sharp strict rank-two/rank-three expressive separation. The inspected prior rank-two theorems explicitly restrict to rank <=2 and do not imply the rank-three 0/1/2 classification. Same-vocabulary deterministic satisfiability theorems and older permutation marginal results do not imply it either. This is a bounded best-of-knowledge original extension with residual risk from broader unindexed random-structure limit laws.
residual_risks: The rank-two components are prior-covered; originality acceptance applies only to the rank-three 50-value extension and exact nine-state classifying invariant.

value.rationale: For a naturally occurring two-independent-Hamiltonian-path structure in finite-model logic, the first strict rank-three transition is a concrete, exact finite logical probability spectrum. The 50-value result is not a textbook restatement of Poisson overlaps: it requires identifying which multiplicity information is visible to 2-variable depth-three formulas and proves expressive optimality of the nine-state abstraction. The exact classifying invariant can be reused for random successor-structure limit theory, even though the rank-two twelve-value baseline and marginal Poisson phenomena are already known. Finite exactness here has natural model-theoretic motivation and is not an arbitrary parameter slice.

limitations: Only ordinary two-variable first-order sentences with the two directed successors and equality, fixed rank<=3, independent uniform finite order samples; no statement for rank>=4, counting quantifiers, additional predicates or full order relations.
